import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    w=params[0]
    c=np.cos(w*t); s=np.sin(w*t)
    return (params[1]+params[2]*x+params[3]*v+params[4]*v*np.abs(v)+params[5]*x*v+params[6]*c+params[7]*s
            +params[8]*v*c+params[9]*v*s)
